authenticity_review: Multiple structural artifacts reduce authenticity: (1) Center bicycle's front fork merges indistinctly with wheel rim (structural collapse, severity 3); (2) Edge bleeding/fusion between rightmost bicycle frame and cow body (severity 3); (3) Zebra rear hooves lack clean boundary with ground, stripes fade unnaturally (texture anomaly, severity 2); (4) Leftmost bicycle handlebars show warped geometry inconsistent with mechanical reality (perspective distortion, severity 2). The cow segmentation mask had borderline confidence (0.847), supporting boundary ambiguity. While overall lighting/composition is photorealistic, these geometric and textural inconsistencies indicate generative artifacts.

Boundary artifact: Fusion between right bicycle and cow
